chapter: The Famous Door, Billy May and the Palomar fire
title: Southland Cafe in Boston after the fire
summary: After the one-nighter trip they rehearsed new charts at the Southland Cafe in Boston.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Yeah. So after the Palomar you went back --

To the Southland. Well, one nighted across the country, to the Southland Cafe in Boston, and then we did a lot of rehearsing and put all the new charts in, and got back to a more disciplined way of playing, because we were romping pretty good on that trip, as you can imagine, you know, with mostly head arrangements and -- but I was lucky that I had a band that had that many head arrangements, because otherwise we'd have been out of business.
